question: A figure is an equiangular parallelogram if and only if it is a
solution:
Equiangular means that all the interior angles are equal. Adjacent angles of a parallelogram sum to \(180^\circ\), because its opposite sides are parallel. If those adjacent angles are equal, each is
\[
180^\circ\div2=90^\circ.
\]
A parallelogram with a right angle is a rectangle.

Conversely, every rectangle is a parallelogram with four right angles, so it is equiangular. Both directions hold, so the answer is rectangle, choice \(\text{A}\).
